fusions.name: Rolled Charge
fusions.desc: Rolls up to 5 tiles to the target and strikes it for 15 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Plate Rattle
fusions.desc: Rattles loose scales around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. You restore 2 health.

fusions.name: Tucked Tight
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Seams Closed
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.
